notes.title: Game Demo Version 2.0 Update is Now Live!
notes.content:
New Content

Added a Shop Scene: Furniture is now acquired by refreshing booths within the scene. The previous furniture-selling function by the shopkeeper has been removed; she now only provides material purchases.

Added Beginner Quests to help players quickly grasp gameplay mechanics.

Added shortcut keys for switching between certain interfaces.

Optimizations

Enhanced UI animations and transition effects.

Improved highlighting and selection feedback for interactive objects.

Added support to deselect furniture by clicking empty spaces.

Optimized character work animations and crafting timers.

Refined sound effect playback, resolving issues with overlapping sounds and audio clipping.

Bug Fixes

Fixed interaction issues including furniture clipping errors and placement abnormalities.

Addressed multiple underlying bugs such as glitches in farming and fishing animations.

"whimsy bake&craft" is coming soon!
Thank you for supporting our game!
